subject: Portfolio headcount request: temporary hold on two offers and role rebalance
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GreenPeak Talent <recruiters@greenpeak.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio headcount — please hold two live offers while we re-evaluate

Mina / Vivek,

Quick heads-up: given the updated Q2 product priorities and an unexpected licensing uptick in the infra budget, I recommend we temporarily hold two pending offers so we can reallocate the budget to a priority data-platform role. Details below — I wanted to get alignment before instructing recruiting to pause signatures.

Affected candidates/offers:
- Allyson Smith — Senior SWE (IC4) — verbal offer extended; counter coming next week.
- Candidate B (external recruiter) — Backend SWE (IC3) — offer pending sign.

Rationale:
- Immediate need to accelerate the data ingestion roadmap (one-time backlog hit).
- Band pressure: both offers are at the top of their bands and would constrain flexibility for the high-priority hire.
- Forecast shows headcount reallocation avoids a hiring freeze but shifts 1.0 FTE-equivalent to Data Eng for June/July.

Attached: quick allocation workbook (hc_allocation_q2_v3.xlsx) and the draft offer packet I shared with Allyson (offer_Allyson_Smith.pdf).

Ask:
1) Approve a temporary hold (7–14 days) on signed offers or start paperwork for Allyson and Candidate B.
2) Approve reallocation of one open IC4 slot from Platform to Data Eng for Q3 hiring.

If you want, I can craft candidate-facing language for the recruiter to use — short, transparent, and offering flexible start-date options.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- hc_allocation_q2_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- offer_Allyson_Smith.pdf (offer draft)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, GreenPeak Talent <recruiters@greenpeak.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio headcount — please hold two live offers while we re-evaluate

Thanks for the quick note and the attachments, Marissa. I skimmed the workbook and have a couple of clarifying questions before I formally approve: 

- The reallocation shows moving 1.0 FTE from Platform IC4. Will that create delivery risk on the upcoming caching rollout? Please add the quantified impact (sprint-level) in tab "RiskNotes".
- For Allyson, is the comp band request above midpoint? I want to confirm we aren't exceeding band guidance for the role.

I'm inclined to approve a short hold on the offers (7 days) to give us time to finalize the shift. If we've got real risk to the rollout, we'll need a mitigation plan (contractor or internal backfill). Vivek — curious on your read; if you want a faster timeline, call me and we can decide today.

Mina Haddad
VP, People & Recruiting
Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Mina / Vivek,
>
> Quick heads-up: given the updated Q2 product priorities and an unexpected licensing uptick in the infra budget, I recommend we temporarily hold two pending offers so we can reallocate the budget to a priority data-platform role....

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio headcount — please hold two live offers while we re-evaluate

Appreciate the fast analysis. A couple of immediate thoughts:

- If the Platform team can absorb a temporary gap, let's prefer a contractor for the caching rollout rather than forcing the hire. That preserves the IC4 slot long-term.
- For Allyson specifically: if the offer is not yet signed, I support holding with a clear recruiter script that explains a brief timeline change ("pause to align org priorities, will follow up within 7 business days"). We should not leave a candidate in limbo more than 10 business days.

Marissa — please add a short recruiter script and confirm if Candidate B's paperwork is further along than Allyson's. If Allyson has already accepted in writing, we may need legal/comp to review the wording before delaying start paperwork.

Vivek
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: GreenPeak Talent <recruiters@greenpeak.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio headcount — please hold two live offers while we re-evaluate

Thanks — updated the workbook (sheet "RiskNotes" completed) and put together the recruiter script below. Candidate statuses: Allyson has not yet signed (verbal acceptance only); Candidate B returned signed intent form but no start date set.

Recruiter script (use as-is):
"Hi [Candidate], thanks so much — we really appreciate your time and enthusiasm. We’re currently doing a brief internal alignment on team priorities and are pausing final paperwork for two roles for up to one week. This is a temporary pause to ensure the role and compensation are fully aligned with business needs; we expect to follow up by [date]. We understand if you need to expedite; please let us know. We remain very interested in your candidacy.

If the candidate asks about compensation we offer: we can confirm the offer is unchanged, but timing is paused. If they press on start date, offer to propose a flexible start window.
"

Attached again: hc_allocation_q2_v3.xlsx and the Allyson offer draft (for reference only). GreenPeak — please pause moving to DocuSign until you hear from us. We will circle back no later than 2027-05-17.

Marissa

Attachments:
- hc_allocation_q2_v3.xlsx (updated)
- offer_Allyson_Smith.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, GreenPeak Talent <recruiters@greenpeak.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio headcount — please hold two live offers while we re-evaluate

Marissa / GreenPeak,

Approved: temporary hold on the two offers for up to 7 calendar days (through 2027-05-19). Key notes:
- Communicate the recruiter script verbatim and avoid suggesting compensation changes — we will not renegotiate during the pause.
- If either candidate asks for immediate acceptance or threatens to withdraw, escalate to me directly and include the candidate's note.
- Explore a short-term contractor for Platform if the team reports >2 sprints of risk; Marissa, please open a short requisition for a 3-month contractor and loop Finance.

Marissa — please confirm when you've informed GreenPeak and mark the HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890. GreenPeak, pause DocuSign and hold all signing until 2027-05-19 unless we reach a different decision.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
VP, People & Recruiting
Redwood Inference
